name: Personalized Dog Bowl
snippet: Your pup's name, your colors. A bowl worthy of their standards.
story: It all started with my dog Feebie — she had a beat-up plastic dish that simply did not suit her dignity. So I made her a proper one. Now I make them for everyone's beloved pups. Tell me your dog's name and your favorite colors, and I'll create something worthy of them.
details: 🎨 Customization: Pet's name + your choice of glaze colors
🍽️ Safety: Food safe, dishwasher safe, kiln-fired
📦 Shipping: USPS flat rate — ships anywhere in the US
